title: GitHub connection
description: Connect a GitHub account so Heimdall can list your repositories and open the CI-install pull request. This is separate from GitHub sign-in and asks for repository access.
notConfigured: GitHub is not set up on this server yet.
notConnected: Not connected. Connect a GitHub account to pick repositories here.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnect GitHub? Heimdall forgets the token; nothing changes on GitHub.
adminOnly: Only an admin can connect or disconnect GitHub.
loadError: Could not load the GitHub status

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Repositories the connected account can see, most recently updated first.
repos.empty: No repositories found for this account.

ci.title: Install the CI gate
ci.description: Opens a pull request on {{repo}} that adds .github/workflows/heimdall.yml. Nothing is merged for you.
ci.pickFirst: Pick a repository above to install the gate.
ci.modeRecorded: Recorded (re-checks a committed sealed experiment, no secrets)
ci.modeLive: Live (runs agents on your self-hosted runner)
ci.noPush: The connected account cannot push to this repository.
